# Daily Briefing – Sunday 4 October

Yesterday was a solid low-key day. No structured training, but 9,886 steps kept you nicely active and your 2,427 calories burned sat right in line with your targets. The main flag is sleep — 4.8 hours simply isn't enough for proper recovery, and that's worth taking seriously.

The good news is your body is holding up well despite the short night. HRV at 101ms sits within your 99–119ms baseline, resting HR is a very healthy 47bpm, and stress at 29/100 is excellent. You're not in a hole, but you're not fully recovered either. Keep today's session moderate — nothing maximal.

With sleep debt on board, prioritise protein today to protect muscle. Hit that 175g target and front-load it earlier in the day. An earlier bedtime tonight will do more for your Chester prep than any single workout. Aim for 8 hours.
